question: how and when to harvest chestnuts
answer: To harvest chestnuts, wait for the spiny burs to split and the nuts to fall from the tree naturally. Harvesting should be done every couple of days to ensure ripe nuts are collected. The nuts generally ripen in late August and September over a span of 10 to 30 days.

Harvesting Chestnut Trees. After the chestnuts fall from the tree, watch for the spiny burs to split. Don’t harvest chestnuts if the burs are still green and closed because the nuts inside will be unripe. Harvest the nuts every couple of days.

When to harvest chestnuts? Chestnuts don’t ripen at the same time and chestnut harvest time can span as much as five weeks, although the nuts generally ripen in a 10- to 30-day span of time in late August and September. Allow the nuts to fall from the tree naturally.
